headline: Lufthansa Cuts 2026 Guidance as Fuel Costs Surge on Iran Conflict
summary: Lufthansa lowered its 2026 outlook and plans to cancel 20,000 short-haul flights to save fuel. European airlines warned that rising jet fuel costs from the war in Iran are weighing on operations.
why: Jet fuel is one of the largest operating expenses for airlines, and surging prices directly compress profit margins and earnings expectations across the aviation sector.

impacts.name: Deutsche Lufthansa AG
impacts.why: Lowered earnings guidance and rising fuel costs directly impact the company's profitability and stock valuation.
